R3B-bear-walk-0002.name: 1.7 km N of Horsefly Lake
R3B-bear-walk-0002.pressureWhy: 2.6 km on foot from the nearest parking (estimate).
R3B-bear-walk-0002.parkWhat: pull off on Viewland FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2017 (9 years old), right here: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2018 (fire C31678), right here: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
Unnamed wetland 50 m SE: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).
